notes: STEP-10 (06 D38, D40): F16's bounce in production's shape - Gmail marks its report Auto-Submitted: auto-replied and attaches the status and the original pitch. Before STEP-10 N-01 archived it; then S2's junk filter did (production's filter called all five real reports junk); and the attached original was a document of its own. Now the report is kept and read, the bounce is on the fund's file and ends its wait, and the original is not a document. No card yet shows a bounce (STEP-14).
